summary: Math.atan2 is implemented in full, following spec steps 1-15 in order. ToNumber(y) and ToNumber(x) run first and propagate with `?`. NaN, the infinity cases, the ±0 cases, the ny>0 and ny<0 special cases, and the general atan(|ny/nx|) path with its quadrant adjustments all match the spec. I checked the signed-zero combinations by hand, for example atan2(+0,-0)=π and atan2(-0,-0)=-π. The only other changes are renaming the now-unused `this`/`new_target` parameters to underscore names, which is needed to avoid unused warnings. No special-casing, no made-up values, and no swallowed errors. The step comments are paraphrased rather than verbatim spec text, and the original full-spec comment block is kept above them, so the comments are duplicated. That is a style nit, not a correctness issue.
